notes.title: Chrsitain video game Throne and Crown launched
notes.notes:
Three points of business:

[h1]POINT OF INETERST 1)  On Throne and Crown Release today Dec 7,2021:[/h1]

You have no idea how much work went into this game. Over 100,000 lines of hand written code, 4 artists, 3 musicians, acclaimed sound track. 2d zeldalike. Enjoy hackney cheesy rush job trailer to a well polished game. We probably spent over 6,000 man hours making this game if you count the techs we made along the way. This is monumental and if you like it, let me know and I’ll keep making updates. I probably have 20,000 hours of content updates I could add. :)

Christian parents long lament they can no longer watch their child watch tv or play video games unsupervised. This game is very Christian. I hope you don’t play it unsupervised tho, because it will be fun to watch your kid play! If we as Christian want Christian media to start to win out vs secular garbage pushed since 1998 cancel culture, we got to start supporting Christian artists making this media. Either way, have a Merry Christmas, and if you want a free copy because you cannot afford one, just let me know how to write you in the comments.

Throne and Crown boasts:

1) Action + RPG which is a solid game style. The action means you need to think and react to situations. The RPG means if you’re not good enough to do the action the first time around, eventually you’ll level up enough to assist you through it. The game plays like famous 2d Z-likes with an overland.

2) There are places to explore and colorful NPCs to meet.

3) The music score impressed just about everyone. I had three musicians sign on to contribute!

4) There are three bosses. There is the Ratiator, the King Crab, and the Goblin King. Aside from my beta tester Ben and myself, no one has beaten the Goblin King.

5) There is a village to help and you can log in daily to help them or you can push through and collect resources yourself by exploring and gathering.

6) There is a “stealth” zone on the beach which is fun, and has island rhythms.

7) The game is designed to be expansive and episodic. Each episode should add new features and a new town to rescue. I really want to make new levels, a castle sim, a roguelike mode, multiplayer and army vs army combat.

8) As a serious video game player for 40 years, I personally enjoy playing this game. It has the features that I enjoy in a game. I’d be really excited if this game takes off so I can keep making future episodes for the next couple years. If this game doesn’t take off at all though, I’m going to keep making video games.

9) Designed for keyboard, but may work for joystick. Some types supported, others should be mapped.

10) Good guy friendly. There are options to be morally grey, but following the path of being the good guy is optimal.


ONE OF THE BEST CHRISTMAS PRESENTs 2021! https://store.steampowered.com/app/1811780/Throne_And_Crown/




[h1]POINT OF INETERST 2)  I got hired to do a job to help the scientific community[/h1]

I really didn't want a job as I have so many games in the pipe, but it literally could ease the supply chain and reduce inflation for our nation, so meh, I'm doin it.

[h1]POINT OF INETERST 3)  Starfighter General dev [/h1]

Between new job, launching TAC for quick money to buy Christmas presents and still fighting illness... I wanted to dev, but missed.  I had one week where I got like only 2.5 hrs a sleep for 6 days straight and its still a fight somedays with 4-8 hrs of exercise needed to stave off neuropathy.  This is not a sob story, just saying what I am fighting through to get you out the MMORPG.  

Also my Starfighter dev team is growing. I'm making Starforge 4.0 map editor for my crew. I might make it public some patch!  Then hold a contest for you guys to make orbital levels n stuff.  Ok, back to coding...

To play Starfighter General (free): https://store.steampowered.com/app/658480/Starfighter_General/
